blind_spots.blind_spot: Neural-net RF inference sized for lab GPUs, not the radio it must ride
blind_spots.operator_reality: Tactical spectrum sensing runs on manpack or vehicle-mounted SDR hardware with hard SWaP ceilings; a model that needs GPU-class compute and cooling never leaves the bench
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team pedigree is telecom/O-RAN and ML research; site frames performance in throughput and reaction time, never watts or platform
blind_spots.evidence_quote: DeepSig's neural network (NN) solutions offer real-time situational awareness in the harshest of environments

blind_spots.blind_spot: Model retraining loop assumes reachback that DDIL denies
blind_spots.operator_reality: New emitters appear in theater; OmniSIG Studio's train-and-deploy cycle presumes connectivity back to a training environment — at a disconnected site the model an operator has is the model they keep
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product architecture built for commercial 5G networks where the pipe to the data center is a given
blind_spots.evidence_quote: software solution for rapidly training, testing, curating, and deploying custom deep learning models and data for new spectrum sensing applications

blind_spots.blind_spot: No visible ATO/RMF path for software that must live on DoD networks
blind_spots.operator_reality: OmniSIG as spectrum-security software touches government networks, which means RMF, STIGs, and impact-level hosting before any unit can legally run it — a months-long clock their FutureG win just started
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Roots and marketing are commercial telecom (MWC, O-RAN PlugFest); compliance vocabulary is absent from every page in the pack
blind_spots.evidence_quote: DeepSig's machine learning-powered OmniSIG software provides best-in-class spectrum awareness across the wideband spectrum in real-time

opener_hook: DeepSig's FutureG OCUDU award and three new service-specific BD reqs put its OmniSIG software on a path to DoD networks that none of its public materials name an ATO route for.
